title: Fix Icon Catalog Gaps: Missing SVGs And Typegen Derive
description:
Pre-existing, unrelated infrastructure gaps in the icon system discovered during the PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER Wave R rename sweep (protocol -> playbook), filed as a dedicated follow-up per that ticket's closing summary.

1. `ui/asset/icon/generated/icon_name.rs` (gitignored, regenerated from `ui/asset/icon/*.svg` by `ui/asset/script.ts`) is missing SVG source files for several icon ids that real application code already references as string literals, e.g. "building" (used by playbook/module/procedural/rs/lib.rs and framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs's test fixture), "help-circle" and "sticky-note" (used by forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs's catalogue_kinds fallback). IconName::from(&str) (around line 1380 of the generated file) does Self::from_str(value).expect("invalid catalog icon name") and panics at runtime whenever one of these strings is used. This currently breaks tests: playbook-module-procedural (module_manifest_contributes_building_component, params_body_includes_media_export_buttons, params_body_lists_flow_inputs), forms-plugin (catalogue_lists_question_kinds, extension_question_emits_external_slot_when_contribution_registered, document_lists_steps, document_tree_declares_drop_action, drop_question_kind_inserts_and_selects, blueprint_builder_card_reflects_selection, forms_labels_resolve_native_english_by_default, forms_labels_resolve_german_locale, renders_blueprint_builder_cards), procedural-plugin (procedural3d_labels_resolve_native_english_by_default, procedural3d_labels_translate_catalogue_and_inspector_in_german), and semio-framework-os (host::tests::contributions_track_plugin_load_and_hot_swap). Fix: find the FULL gap (grep all icon id string literals referenced across the codebase vs what's in icon_name.rs's FromStr impl, not just the three examples above), add the missing SVG source files under ui/asset/icon/*.svg (handcrafted, no placeholders/migrations per repo rules), then regenerate via ui/asset/📜️script.ts's generate command.

2. IconName (same generated file) has no #[cfg_attr(feature = "typegen", derive(ts_rs::TS))], unlike other types that participate in the framework-core -> TypeScript mirror. This means `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate` fails to compile ui_wgpu with --features typegen (error: the trait bound IconName: TS is not satisfied, at ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs:518 where BlockPaletteEntry.icon_id: IconName is used under a #[derive(ts_rs::TS)] struct). This blocks regenerating framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts entirely. Fix: update ui/asset/📜️script.ts's icon-catalog generator to also emit the ts-rs derive (feature-gated like the rest of the codebase's typegen pattern) and an appropriate TS export, then re-run both the icon generator and bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate.

After fixing both, check whether framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts still contains a stale "kind": "protocolBlockKind" entry for the Contribution type (it should say "playbookBlockKind" since framework/core/rs/lib.rs's Contribution::PlaybookBlockKind variant was already renamed in Wave R, but the generated TS mirror couldn't be refreshed due to blocker #2). If stale, running the generator should fix it automatically once IconName compiles under typegen.

Confirm all previously-panicking tests now pass by actually running them, not by assumption.
summary:
Fixed both pre-existing icon-system gaps filed as a follow-up from the PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER Wave R rename ticket.

(1) Missing SVGs: the ticket named 3 example ids (building, help-circle, sticky-note), but a ground-truth sweep (temporarily made IconName::from log-and-fallback instead of panic, then ran the 4 affected crates' full test suites with --nocapture) found 21 missing icon ids in total, not just 3 — static grepping for `icon_id: "..."` patterns alone missed match-arm-style (`"slider" => (label, "sliders-horizontal")`) and other call shapes. Added handcrafted Lucide-style stroke SVGs under ui/asset/icon/*.svg for all 21: building, help-circle, sticky-note, beam, edit, export, folder-plus, import, pencil, play-circle, scan, slab, toggle-left, trash, type, window, calendar, cpu, list-checks, palette, sliders-horizontal. Regenerated all bindings via `bun ui/asset/script.ts generate all` (245 icons total, up from 224).

(2) Missing typegen derive: added `#[cfg_attr(feature = "typegen", derive(ts_rs::TS))]` to the generated IconName enum by updating ui/asset/📜️script.ts's generateRust() to emit it (existing #[serde(rename = "...")] per-variant is honored automatically by ts-rs's serde-compat default feature). Added the missing `ui_wgpu::IconName::export().unwrap();` call to framework/core/rs/lib.rs's exports_typescript_bindings typegen test (the type had the capability but was never in the export list). Declared an empty `typegen = []` feature in infinite/canvas/rs/Cargo.toml so the shared cfg_attr (icon_name.rs is also #[path]-included there) doesn't trip `unexpected_cfgs` there — infinite_canvas doesn't itself export TS bindings for IconName, ui_wgpu does.

`bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate` now runs clean end-to-end and refreshed framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts (gitignored). Confirmed the previously-stuck stale entry is fixed: manifest.ts now says "kind": "playbookBlockKind" (was blocked on regeneration by gap #2, source enum was already renamed in Wave R).

Verified with actual test runs (not assumption): cargo test -p playbook-module-procedural -p forms-plugin -p procedural-plugin -p semio-framework-os --lib --no-fail-fast. All originally-listed panicking tests now pass (playbook-module-procedural 14/14, semio-framework-os 55/55, forms-plugin 30/31, procedural-plugin 42/43). The 2 remaining failures (forms-plugin::try_wizard_gates_navigation_and_reports_inline_errors, procedural-plugin::node_graph_hover_updates_preview_selection_and_graph_scene) are pre-existing and unrelated to icons — confirmed via --nocapture that zero UNKNOWN_ICON events fire anywhere in these 4 crates' full test suites. Also confirmed cargo build -p ui_wgpu --features typegen and cargo build -p infinite_canvas both compile clean. Note: cargo test --workspace fails to build entirely due to a pre-existing, unrelated compile error in ui_tui (missing ChromePalette fields hover_panel/temporary) — not touched by or related to this ticket.
